profile_text.body:
Apollo Global Management is a public company, traded under the ticker APO, that describes itself as an asset manager, capital provider, and provider of wealth and retirement solutions. On its own site the firm says it creates strategies it calls innovative and differentiated, and presents itself as a future-focused asset manager and a leader in wealth management and retirement solutions. It highlights private credit as a way to promote resiliency in financial systems, fuel business growth, and power retirement income, and says it is addressing approximately $90T worth of investments needed to power what it calls the Global Industrial Renaissance.

The site also points to Apollo's long-duration capital and aviation expertise, citing work with an airline it describes as one of the world's leading, and notes that Apollo and Athene have been delivering investment solutions across the retirement ecosystem for more than three decades. It publishes perspectives, case studies, and research on private markets, and features senior leaders discussing the firm's progress, growth opportunities, strategy, and financial outlook.

Beyond that, the record holds little: no products, no MCP servers, and no lawsuits are listed. The company is registered with the SEC under CIK 0001858681.
